user.title: Device Watchdog
user.description: Choose the entities to watch. Enter one entity ID per line, or separate them with commas. An entity that stays unavailable longer than the offline threshold triggers a notification.

data_description.entities: Entity IDs separated by new lines or commas, for example sensor.plug_power and light.hallway.
data_description.offline_after_minutes: How long an entity must stay unavailable before the first notification is sent. Minimum 1 minute.
data_description.repeat_minutes: How often to repeat the notification while the entity is still offline. Minimum 5 minutes.
data_description.notify_service: Optional notification service, for example notify.24117rn76e. Mobile app and Telegram notifiers are supported.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also create a persistent notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.watch_unknown: Also treat the 'unknown' state as offline. Useful for sensors that lose their value without becoming unavailable.
data_description.ignore_startup_minutes: Do not send notifications during the first minutes after the integration is loaded, so slow integrations do not cause false alarms.

error.no_entities: Add at least one entity to watch.
